prompt: A brutally simple, monochrome 2D exam-style diagram of two solid spheres falling through a fluid. Setup: A tall rectangular tank is partially filled with fluid, indicated by a simple horizontal surface line near the top. Completely submerged in the fluid are two spheres. The left sphere is small. The right sphere is visibly larger (about 3 to 4 times the diameter of the left sphere). Both spheres are positioned side-by-side at roughly the same depth. Labels: Label 'X' is centred inside the smaller left sphere. Label 'Y' is centred inside the larger right sphere. Label 'fluid' is placed outside the tank to the right. A single straight leader line goes from the text 'fluid', enters the tank, and ends on an empty patch of fluid between the right sphere and the tank wall. The leader must NOT point at or touch either sphere, the tank walls, or the surface line. Style: Pure white background (#FFFFFF). Crisp black vector-like line art. Times New Roman-like serif font. No extra labels, no force arrows, no velocity arrows, no motion lines, no 3D rendering, no shading. Illustrative only.
negative_prompt: Pure white background only; no grey paper, gradient, or texture. No extra labels. No overlap. No sans-serif fonts. No decorative shading. No photorealism. No colour unless explicitly requested. No exact answer-bearing measurements. No clutter. No malformed symbols. Do not place objects in the wrong support/location relationship. No medium label pointing at objects inside the medium. No fluid label terminating on a sphere, wall, or meniscus. No unrequested arrows, force labels, field symbols, construction arcs, motion blur, or explanatory overlays.

label_anchors.text_placement: centred inside the smaller left sphere
centred inside the larger right sphere

must_show_relations: Both spheres must be fully submerged beneath the fluid surface.
Sphere Y must be visibly larger than sphere X.
relative_size_constraints: Sphere Y is significantly larger in diameter than sphere X.

hard_constraints: Sphere Y must be visibly larger than sphere X
Both spheres must be completely submerged
Label fluid: text outside tank; leader ends on empty fluid, not on sphere X or Y
No unrequested arrows, force labels, or motion lines
Background must be pure white #FFFFFF with no grey fill or gradient
